principles: Every event must answer a decision.
Server-owned outcomes should be emitted or validated by the server where practical.
Do not collect unnecessary personal data.

events.name: search_performed
events.decision: Understand search demand and search-to-course discovery.
events.source: client with server query context when available

events.name: filter_applied
events.decision: Understand which discovery filters contribute to course finding.

events.name: course_viewed
events.decision: Measure course-detail reach and downstream registration conversion.

events.name: provider_viewed
events.decision: Measure provider discovery and trust behavior.

events.name: payment_succeeded
events.decision: Measure paid registration and revenue outcomes.

events.name: payment_failed
events.decision: Measure payment reliability and failure categories.

events.name: refund_requested
events.decision: Measure refund/support burden and policy quality.

events.name: support_ticket_created
events.decision: Measure support demand by journey and issue category.
